About
Our Live Performance

An instrumental five-piece, no vocals — no language barrier. We adapt from festival main-stage volume to intimate, low-volume sets. Daytime sets that suit outdoor afternoon stages, sunset sets timed for the golden hour, late-night club builds — we tailor the setlist to your time slot. Having organized our own events since 2013, we understand changeover times, volume restrictions, and audience flow from the programmer's side.

About the Band
"We screened films and spun records by the sea in Zushi. Doing that long enough, we started making music ourselves."

Half Mile Beach Club is an instrumental band formed in Zushi, Kanagawa, and based in Tokyo. Since 2013 we've operated as a collective hosting self-organized events at Cinema Amigo in Zushi — film screenings combined with live music and DJs. The band project grew out of that scene. The sound fuses Latin jazz rhythms, club music textures, and indie rock energy, performed entirely on live instruments with no vocals.

Produced by Saito "JxJx" Jun (YOUR SONG IS GOOD), the band fully transitioned to instrumental in 2022. Following the second album "Days of the Ocean Waves" (2024, distributed by P-VINE, vinyl available), a remix album dropped in August 2025 featuring Paris-based Hugo LX alongside other Japanese and international producers.

The four members (guitar, bass, drums, synthesizer) perform live as a five-piece with a guest percussionist. Each member also works as a DJ, producer, or visual designer; all artwork and flyers are designed by member Asakura Tsukue.
